hero.badge: Umukannyi wa Porogaramu (Back End) @ Qonics Inc
hero.description: Umukannyi wa porogaramu uzobereye mu gukora inyuma ya porogaramu (Backend) akoresheje Golang, Python, Node.js, PHP n'ikoranabuhanga rya cloud. Gukora sisitemu nini, itekanye kandi ikora neza.

about.title: Ibyerekeye
about.subtitle: Umukannyi wa porogaramu uzobereye  mu gukora inyuma ya porogaramu (Backend) akoresheje Golang, Python, Node.js, PHP n'ikoranabuhanga rya cloud. Gukora sisitemu nini, itekanye kandi ikora neza.
about.description1: Kugeza ubu, nkorera muri Qonics Inc nka Back-End Developer, aho nshyira imbaraga mu gukora sisitemu zikora neza, zitekanye kandi zaguka. Inshingano zanjye zirimo iterambere rya web backend, gusesengura sisitemu, no gutanga ibisubizo bifite ireme kugira ngo dushyigikire intego z'ubucuruzi.
about.description2: Usibye iterambere, nishimira no gusangira ubumenyi. Nka mwarimu muri Lycee Saint Alexandre Sauli de Muhura no muri Bright Academy TSS, nigishije gukora porogaramu bijyanye n'imiyoboro y'ikoranabuhanga, naha abanyeshuri ubumenyi ngiro kugira ngo babashe guhangana n'imbogamizi zo mu isi ya tekinoloji.

backend.title: Iterambere rya Back-End
backend.description: Gukora sisitemu zikora neza, zitekanye kandi zaguka hakoreshejwe uburyo n'ububiko bw'amakuru bigezweho

problem_solving.title: Gusesengura Ibibazo
problem_solving.description: Ubumenyi bukomeye mu gukosora amakosa n'ubushobozi bwo gukemura ibibazo mu buryo buhanga

mentoring.title: Kwigisha n'Ubujyanama
mentoring.description: Gusangira ubumenyi mu gukora porogaramu n'imiyoboro y'ikoranabuhanga mu bigo by'amashuri

experience.title: Inararibonye mu Nganda
experience.description: Gukorana n'ibigo by'amashuri ndetse n'imishinga yo mu nganda

skills.title: Ubumenyi bwa
skills.subtitle: Inzobere mu kumenya ikoranabuhanga n'uburyo butandukanye, hibandwa ku iterambere rya backend n'imyubakire ya sisitemu zaguka.

services.title: Serivisi
services.subtitle: Serivisi zuzuye zo gukora porogaramu zigenewe gukemura ibibazo by'ubucuruzi bwawe no guteza imbere udushya.

android.title: Iterambere rya Android
android.description: Gukora porogaramu za Android hakoreshejwe uburyo bugezweho kugira ngo zikore neza cyane.

application.title: Iterambere rya Porogaramu
application.description: Ibisubizo bya porogaramu byihariye bijyanye n'ubucuruzi bwawe, kuva ku gitekerezo kugeza ishyirwa mu bikorwa.

web_design.title: Gukora Isura y'Imbuga
web_design.description: Gukora isura y'imbuga za interineti nziza kandi yoroshye gukoreshwa ihuje n'ikirango cyawe.

web_dev.title: Gukora Imbuga za Interineti
web_dev.description: Iterambere ryuzuye ry'imbuga za interineti ryibanda kuri sisitemu za backend zaguka n'isura y'imbere ijyanye n'igihe.

ux.title: Gukora Isura y'Abakoresha
ux.description: Gukora isura y'abakoresha yoroshye gukoreshwa ituma abantu bishimira porogaramu.

testing.title: Gupima Porogaramu
testing.description: Serivisi zuzuye zo gupima porogaramu zizera ireme, kwizerwa, n'imikorere myiza ya porogaramu zawe.

mobile.title: Iterambere rya Porogaramu zigendanwa

security.title: Umutekano w'Amakuru

database.title: Iterambere ry'Ububiko bw'Amakuru
database.description: Gushushanya no kunoza imyubakire y'ububiko bw'amakuru kugira ngo zikore neza, zaguke kandi zizerwe.

leazi.title: Leazi
leazi.description: Uburyo bugezweho bwa SaaS bwo gucunga imitungo
leazi.longDescription: Leazi ni uburyo bugezweho bwa SaaS bwo gucunga imitungo buhindura uburyo ucunga imitungo, abakodesha, n'imari. Yakozwe n'uburyo bugezweho bwa microservices, Leazi itanga imikorere itangaje n'umutekano ku barimo gucunga imitungo ku isi yose.

geco.title: GECO Rwanda
geco.description: Ubuyobozi mu kwitaho ku ndwara y'igicuri kuva muri 2010
geco.longDescription: GECO RWANDA yiyemeje gutanga ubuvuzi bwuzuye bw'igicuri, kurwanya akato, no kubaka imiryango irimo bose mu Rwanda. Guhindura ubuzima binyuze mu kwitaho kuva muri 2010.

tmis.title: Tontine MIS (TMIS)
tmis.description: Sisitemu yo gucunga amakuru ya Tontine
tmis.longDescription: Sisitemu yuzuye yo gucunga amakuru ya Tontine yakozwe na Nuxt.js. Yoroshya imikorere ya tontine, gucunga abanyamuryango, no gukurikirana imari ku matsinda yo kuzigama.

menya.title: Menya-Tech
menya.longDescription: Uburyo bwuzuye bwo kwiga ikoranabuhanga n'udushya, bushyigikira iterambere rya porogaramu (SOD), Networking, Multimedia, n'ibindi bigo by'amashuri makuru.

marketspot.title: Market Spot MIS
marketspot.longDescription: Sisitemu yo gucunga amakuru y'isoko ku buryo bw'ubwenge yo gukurikirana abacuruzi, ibibanza, n'imikorere y'isoko.

smartmarket.title: Smart Market MIS
smartmarket.longDescription: Sisitemu yo gucunga isoko ifite ibikoresho byo gusesengura amakuru n'izindi miterere ifasha mu gutanga raporo.

tontinehub.title: TontineHub
tontinehub.description: Kuzigama Hamwe. Gukura Hamwe. Gutsinda Hamwe.
tontinehub.longDescription: TontineHub ikemura  ibibazo by'itumanaho n'inyandiko nki mpapuro . Nta spreadsheet. Nta ngorane. Ifaranga ryose rikurikiranwa mu gihe nyacyo. Inguzanyo zemezwa mu minota mike. Abanyamuryango barenga 10,000 bazigama.
